description: Image Description: The image shows a simple, hand-drawn white curve resembling a right-facing, roughly horizontal arc or small hook on a black background. The curve starts with a small upward flick on the left, extends to the right, and slightly curves downward, forming an open-ended shape. The lines are relatively thin and uniform in thickness, with a smooth and continuous appearance. The background is entirely black, providing a stark contrast to the white curve.
